• Performed trade capture and trade enrichment by validating trade details, settlement instructions (SSI), counterparty information, security master 
data, and pricing attributes to ensure accurate downstream processing.  
• Utilized SmartStream TLM (Transaction Lifecycle Management) to perform cash and stock reconciliations, investigate reconciliation breaks, conduct 
root cause analysis, and resolve exceptions to support seamless trade processing.  
• Monitored and resolved trade processing and settlement exceptions, collaborating with custodians, brokers, and global operations teams to 
minimize settlement fails and improve straight-through processing (STP) efficiency.  
• Supported institutional fund operations through trade processing, NAV impact validation, corporate actions, reconciliation, and settlement controls, 
ensuring operational accuracy, regulatory compliance, and timely client deliverables.
